feature: Army needs: rifle-ammunition supply facts and explicit cancellation recovery
design_before_code: The prospective diagram/owner contract was saved before lead model/navigation implementation and supplied to the isolated UI developer before the panel handoff. Static design is not a runtime trace.
behaviour: Ordinary Army needs navigation exposes reported rifle needs, carried/committed ammunition, separate accessible rear/HQ/forward stocks and actual request receipts.
Physical forward loaded/unloaded counters are cumulative handling facts, not present cargo or invented rear-to-forward lineage.
Explicit idempotent resume clears only a cancellation hold and cancelled automatic mapping; genuine need is recomputed at the next existing owner decision.
Batch stock counts across holders and personal ammunition/commitments avoid per-recipient world reads. A request-free opening skips personal-round reads.
Scene-owned UI coalesces visible committed-state/intent notifications, retains widgets and recipient identity, disconnects old bindings and rejects stale actions.
Ordinary production/workforce/request navigation reuses existing controls; observation focuses a validated friendly identity without a tactical command.

verification.result: All three fixed checks passed in14.1077 seconds: new-feature headless demonstration, living system map and clickable UI map. No repair worker invocation was needed.

Pass: actual6000 HQ/zero rear opening, absent reported shortage, read purity/detachment, manual cancellation/hold and idempotent resume preserving cancelled request/no new request/no goods mutation while paused, idle/hidden/burst/rebind UI lifecycle, ordinary main-scene integration, exact request subtab, valid friendly observation/missing-identity rejection and clean model audit.
Actual root editor imported headlessly with exit0 and empty stderr.

Source review caught a disconnected factory-component fixture before first feature-check execution. Original draft preserved; the checked fixture uses the actual connected authored opening, without changing stock/rates/limits.

handoff.scope: Only scene-owned army_supply_panel.gd and its UID. Lead reviewed the complete panel and supplied authoritative data/actions/navigation plus combined verification.

unchanged: No starting stock, recipe, price, physical rate, clock policy or performance ceiling changed. No fabricated military shortage or test cargo grant.
limits: Rifle ammunition only; this is not the complete multi-resource military demand planner.
The check verifies this new view and intent commands, not a useful ordinary full delivery/replenishment cycle, native input,1x pacing or60FPS.
Non-empty reported-recipient/forward-job states and cancelled automatic-source republishing were reviewed in source but are not demonstrated by this brief opening fixture.
The panel reuses the broad committed-state signal while visible; independently progressing domain-clock and scoped event migration is unfinished.
Historical frame failures remain open while polishing/optimization are paused.

principles.ownership: One authoritative intent owner and existing physical owners; commands and read-only projections stay separate.
principles.events: Observer-style scene subscriptions and finite deferred presentation; no new time/frame polling.
principles.cost: Batch the few required facts once per visible committed update; no world export in the new reader.
principles.safety: Idempotent explicit intent recovery, weak lifecycle references, callback generations and click-time action validation.
